name: genexus_k2b_designer
description: Inspect and edit an already-active K2B WebPanel Designer through the open GeneXus IDE document. The IDE bridge must be installed and started with the same explicit KB and pipe. No inactive Designer activation or pattern conversion is performed. Edits require expectedVersion; preview returns a read-only change summary; saves use the native IDE path and should be independently reread.

name.description: Name of an open WebPanel with an active K2B Designer.

action.description: Inspect the active Designer, read its tree, preview a change, or apply a typed edit.

path.description: Designer node path returned by tree; root is root.

property.description: Exact SDK property name for set_property.

value.description: Property value in the K2B SDK string format.

nodeType.description: SDK node type offered by the Designer for add_node.

index.description: Optional destination child index for move_node.

expectedVersion.description: Version from inspect, tree, or preview; required for mutations.

name: genexus_data_view
description: Native, typed, atomic Transaction + Data View authoring over an existing physical table. action=inspect|dry_run|create|update|delete. dry_run performs validation without constructing or saving SDK objects. create/update persist the root-only Transaction and Data View, then reread and verify the committed pair; commit and verification status are reported separately. action=delete is destructive and requires confirm=true when dryRun=false. No action implicitly runs Specify, Generate, Build, Rebuild, Reorg, compilation, publish, execution, or tests; the response includes a no-DDL reorg preview.

action.description: Operation to inspect, preview, create, update, or delete a native Data View mapping.

dataViewName.description: Data View name associated with the Transaction logical table.

dataStore.description: Existing GeneXus data store category (default Default).

table.description: Existing physical table and GeneXus table-metadata name.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token returned by inspect/dry_run/create/update/delete preview.

dryRun.description: Forces every action to remain read-only; create/update validate their complete definition and delete returns a deletion preview.

confirm.description: Required for action=delete when dryRun=false; explicitly authorizes removing the Transaction and Data View.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Atomic SDK rollback is always enforced; this flag records the caller's rollback intent.

name: genexus_whoami
description: KB context + version + health (worker/index/database) + next-step hints. Call FIRST every session. Lean by default; pass verbose=true ONCE for the inline playbooks + skills catalog of verified GeneXus reference resources (navigation, GAM, SD panel, WebPanel events). For a minimal connection+index health check use genexus_doctor.

verbose.description: Include the static playbooks + skills catalog + per-tool stats/heatmap. Default false (lean health payload).

name: genexus_recipe
description: Named playbooks + self-extending macros. action=list|describe|suggest_macro|crystallize.

action.description: list: show recipes; describe: inspect recipe; suggest_macro: detect repeated sequences; crystallize: save sequence as recipe.

items.description: Tool call step object or template.

steps.description: crystallize: ordered array of tool call steps to include in the macro.

name: genexus_query
description: Search objects in active KB. Prefixes: name:, type:, usedby:, parent:, parentPath:, description:. name:"X" (or bare quoted "X") demands exact-name match — use it when you know the object's name. Compact by default. See genexus://kb/tool-help/genexus_query. Requires the KB index to be Ready — check genexus_lifecycle action=status if results look empty.

sort.description: relevance (default) or lastUpdate (newest first; bypasses score ranking).

since.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate >= since.

modifiedBefore.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate < modifiedBefore.

cursor.description: Opaque token from prior nextCursor. Use with sort=lastUpdate for stable paging.

name: genexus_list_objects
description: List objects with pagination. Feed nextOffset until hasMore=false. Every item exposes its persisted GUID and path; verbose=true also exposes the typed EntityKey when available.

filter.description: Legacy: name OR description. Prefer nameFilter/descriptionFilter.

since.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate >= since.

modifiedBefore.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only items with lastUpdate < modifiedBefore.

cursor.description: Opaque token from prior nextCursor. Use with sort=lastUpdate for stable paging.

projection.description: minimal=name+type+lastUpdate; standard=default compact; verbose=all fields. Overrides axiCompact when set.

name: genexus_read
description: Read object code and metadata. Omitting 'part' (RECOMMENDED) returns the COMPLETE object in 1 call (rules with parm, source/events, variables, structure, called signatures) tailored to the object type. Resolve modular objects by name/type, persisted GUID, EntityKey, or path. Pass 'part' only for targeted single-part reads. Response carries versionToken for safe writes. See genexus://kb/tool-help/genexus_read.

entityKey.description: Typed GeneXus EntityKey from genexus_list_objects verbose output.

parts.description: Selected parts; unavailable DataSelector parts appear in unsupportedParts. Mutually exclusive with part/offset/limit.

name: genexus_edit
description: Edit object part. name or targets (exclusive). mode: full|patch|ops. dryRun first. async=true returns an operationId for lifecycle polling. Text payloads for Source/Rules/Events/Code must contain real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence with LiteralLineBreaksDetected. For WWP edit host's PatternInstance NOT the parent WebForm (gets overwritten on reapply). Uncertain about a property/method/event? → resources/read uri=genexus://kb/skills/navigation (or gam-integrated-security / sd-panel-mobile / webpanel-events) first.

parts.description: Multi-part edit on a single object. Each item: {part, content, mode?}. Saves the object once atomically. Text content must use real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence.

ops.description: GeneXus semantic ops (NOT RFC 6902 JSON-Patch). Each item: {op, args}. Supported ops: set_attribute, add_attribute, remove_attribute (Transaction); add_rule, remove_rule (Transaction/Procedure/WebPanel); set_property (any kind). Use mode=patch for textual find/replace.

args.description: Op-specific args. set_attribute: {name, type?, description?}. add_attribute: {name, type, ...}. add_rule: {rule}. set_property: {name, value}.

patch.description: Shorthand for {find,replace} on mode=patch: find is the exact existing text, replace is inserted literally (no auto-indentation). Optional opt-in protections: scope bounds the search region, indentation validates the replacement's base indent. Both apply ONLY to this shape — never with operation, mode=ops, targets[], parts[], Insert_After or Append.

find.description: Exact existing text to find. Real line breaks; tabs/spaces must match the part.

scope.description: Region delimited by complete-line anchors: editable starts after scope.start's last line and ends before scope.end's first line (EOF when end is omitted). Anchors stay outside the region, are compared with only CRLF/LF normalized, and must each be unique. Errors: ScopeStartRequired, ScopeAnchorNotFound, ScopeAnchorAmbiguous, ScopeAnchorNotComparable. The response reports editableStartLine, editableEndLineExclusive and scopeEndsAtEof.

start.description: Required. Unique complete-line anchor ending immediately before the editable region.

end.description: Optional. Unique complete-line anchor starting immediately after the editable region. Omitted = region runs to EOF.

indentation.description: Validates the base indentation of the located match against the first line of replace before persisting; tabs and spaces are distinct and nothing is reformatted. With replaceAll=true every match is validated. Errors: IndentationMismatch, IndentationNotComparable.

mode.description: validate: block the write when the replacement's base indentation differs from the matched line's.

scope.description: patch.scope may also be passed at the top level. Honored ONLY by the abbreviated patch={find,replace} form; combined with operation, mode=ops, targets[], parts[], Insert_After or Append the call is rejected with ScopeUnsupportedPatchForm and nothing is written.

indentation.description: patch.indentation may also be passed at the top level. Honored ONLY by the abbreviated patch={find,replace} form; combined with operation, mode=ops, targets[], parts[], Insert_After or Append the call is rejected with IndentationUnsupportedPatchForm and nothing is written.

context.description: Exact existing text to find (Replace) or anchor after (Insert_After). Required for both. For text parts, send real line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before persistence.

replaceAll.description: patch mode only. Apply to ALL occurrences instead of requiring expectedCount to match exactly.

async.description: Run as a background job. Result returns operationId/job_id for genexus_lifecycle polling.

estimated_seconds.description: When async=true, expected runtime used for progress/job metadata (default 30).

targets.description: Multi-target Source/Rules writes. Each target may include expectedVersion/baseVersion; all versions are checked before the first write.

validate.description: strict (default) aborts on first error and post-write-verifies visual/PatternInstance writes (re-reads + diffs the persisted XML). best-effort applies what compiles and SKIPS the post-write XML re-read/diff (faster on large WebForm/PatternInstance writes; build to confirm). only runs in-memory, no persist.

validationMode.description: Issue #60: run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen, no Compile) against the edited object right after the write, returning structured spc*/gen* diagnostics in the same call. Combines with rollbackOnFailure.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Explicit rollback only. Full Source verification failure reports AtomicRollbackUnavailable without a restore write until atomic conditional restore is supported. Other paths require a valid snapshot. No rollback when false or omitted.

requireObjectSave.description: Full Source requires transactional object save. Events patch: dryRun available; real writes blocked by ObjectSaveIsolationUnverified until SDK/pattern save-event isolation is established. No override; baseVersion required.

forceWrite.description: WebForm only: persist despite SDK WebForm validation errors; response includes validationOverridden=true.

verifyMode.description: Post-save text comparison. Full exact compares public-read text verbatim; patch exact retains logical CRLF/LF equivalence. normalized ignores EOL, BOM, trailing whitespace and blank lines; semantic also tolerates casing/spacing. Fresh reread always required. sdkSaveCompleted/saved report physical save; persistedStateKnown and postSaveVerification report read evidence. Mismatch never retries automatically.

visualVerify.description: Post-edit headless screenshot + pixel-diff vs baseline. See tool-help.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency: pass the versionToken from the genexus_read this edit is based on. If the object changed since (e.g. edited in the IDE), the write is refused with VersionConflict instead of overwriting the newer version. Omit to skip the check.

expectedVersion.description: Alias of baseVersion. The write is refused when the current version no longer matches.

concurrencyPolicy.description: warn (default) or fail_if_open if open in GeneXus IDE.

autoDeclareVariables.description: When true, scans updated source for newly referenced &Variable tokens and auto-declares them in VariablesPart.

module.description: mode=ops: Transaction module for modular objects.

name: genexus_inspect
description: Use this for a compact object snapshot: metadata, variables, structure, signature and navigation context. Modular objects accept persisted GUID, EntityKey, or path in addition to name/type. Don't use it when you need full Source or exact part bytes; use genexus_read for that. runtimeIds needs a prior build.

entityKey.description: Typed GeneXus EntityKey from genexus_list_objects verbose output.

projection.description: Token budget. minimal=name/type/lastUpdate; standard=default (vars≤40 name+type, source heads 1200c); verbose=full vars + 8000c heads.

name: genexus_analyze
description: Use this for cross-object semantic analysis. mode=context (alias deep_context) returns 360° task context in 1 call (object + called procedures' parm signatures + referenced tables' schemas/PKs + SDTs + callers). Other modes: impact, callers, hierarchy, navigation, linter, summary, explain. mode=explain is compatibility-only: it preserves the legacy response envelope and returns NotImplemented; use mode=summary for a concise overview, mode=context for 360° task context, or genexus_read for source. Requires Ready index for impact/callers.

code.description: mode=explain: legacy code snippet carried through the compatibility-only envelope; the result is NotImplemented. Use mode=summary, mode=context, or genexus_read for supported analysis.

cursor.description: mode=context: continuation cursor returned by a budgeted context page.

format.description: mode=dependency_heatmap: ascii adds rendered bar chart.

maxBytes.description: mode=context: maximum UTF-8 bytes for the returned context bundle (bounded by the server).

waitForIndex.description: mode=impact: block up to 30s for Ready index (default true).

dryRun.description: mode=linter: with fix=true, reject the unsupported combination before any SDK read; with fix=false, lint remains read-only.

fix.description: mode=linter: apply automatic fixes to the KB.

waitTimeoutMs.description: mode=impact: maximum index wait in milliseconds.

name: genexus_lifecycle
description: Build, validate, index, or poll the KB. action=build_all runs the native incremental Build All for the entire selected KB (ForceRebuild=false); it rejects target, refuses silent reorganization, and returns completion evidence. action=rebuild remains the forced Rebuild All path. action=specify runs Spec+Gen only. action=build with mode=compile_check checks targets plus transitive callers without KB-wide DeveloperMenu regeneration. Long operations are async with operationId. dryRun=true previews without executing. Build results carry generateEvidence and effective_status. See genexus://kb/tool-help/genexus_lifecycle for actions and target formats.

action.description: Lifecycle action to perform.

mode.description: With action=build: compile_check spec+gen+compiles target(s) plus their transitive callers and SKIPS the KB-wide DeveloperMenu regen (the dominant build-all cost). Fast 'did my edit break the build?' check; requires target.

target.description: Object/task ID/op:<id>. compile_check accepts unique name, Type:Name, GUID; no paths. build_all rejects target.

code.description: validate: in-memory code to check without persisting.

limit.description: validate-kb: maximum number of objects/conditions to validate.

snapshotPath.description: snapshots-restore: path to pattern snapshot to restore.

wait_until_done.description: Build/build_all/rebuild: block in one turn until terminal (up to wait_seconds, default 600).

wait.description: Status block, 0-600s. With a build taskId (or since): event-driven, returns on change. On index status with no since: blocks until index is Ready.

freshness.description: Status: freshness target for the wait. With wait and no since, the call blocks until the index status is Ready AND freshness matches, then reports waitSatisfied. Use freshness=current to wait for a warm-start delta refresh to finish (a snapshot restored from the warm cache is Ready but stale, so a status-only wait returns immediately).

dryRun.description: build/build_all/rebuild/index: returns the plan without executing.

environment.description: Build: target environment name/folder. Switches active environment before building.

includeCallees.description: Build: expand call graph so callees compile first (default transitive).

callers.description: compile_check: expand transitive callers of the target (default true). Set false for a target-only check when the target is a base transaction/BC with a huge caller closure.

callerCap.description: compile_check: max callers to pull into the check (default 40). Closure beyond this is truncated and flagged.

deploy.description: Build: force the full deploy (Theme/Image/Style/Module copy to web/bin + WebAppConfig) so the built object is runnable, not just compiled. Default false (fast compile-only path). Slower; use when you need to run/preview the object.

part.description: validate: specific object part to check (e.g. Source, Rules).

page.description: status/result: 1-based page number for paginated results.

pageSize.description: status/result: page size for paginated results (default 50).

notifyOnFailure.description: build: Slack/Discord webhook URL to notify on terminal build failure.

skipFullDeploy.description: build: skip full deployment stage to speed up compile pass.

fastIncremental.description: build: experimental fast incremental build opt-in.

operationKey.description: inspect/reconcile: original idempotency key; journal lookup is hash-scoped to the resolved KB.

operationTool.description: inspect/reconcile: canonical mutating tool that owns the idempotency key, e.g. genexus_edit.

confirmed.description: reconcile: must be true after independently reading the affected target; this never authorizes a retry with the same key.

verification.description: reconcile: short operator/model verification statement. Only a hash is persisted; source and KB content are never journaled.

observedTargetIds.description: reconcile: target names observed by an independent read; send one name as a single-item array. Must match the durable target fence.

observedRevision.description: reconcile: revision/version observed by an independent read; must match the durable revision fence.

outputSchema.description: Structured lifecycle result. Action-specific fields remain additive; text content is preserved for legacy clients.

name: genexus_test
description: Execute native GeneXus tests (GXtest).

name: genexus_sdk_probe
description: Read the GeneXus SDK surface. mode=surface dumps types/methods/props to docs/sdk-probe/; mode=capabilities returns an in-memory capability matrix with honest signature-probe status.

mode.description: surface (default) writes the diagnostic probe; capabilities is read-only and returns status/evidence.

name: genexus_worker_reload
description: Reload worker. mode=soft drains and respawns; mode=hard copies sourceDir during the drain window and respawns. force=true kills and respawns a wedged Worker, but cannot be combined with mode=hard; no Worker is stopped when that combination is rejected. See tool-help.

force.description: Bypass drain; gateway kills + respawns. Use with mode=soft when the Worker is wedged; force=true + mode=hard is rejected before stopping anything.

alias.description: KB alias to reload when more than one worker is open.

name: genexus_connection_recover
description: Probes every open worker and recovers unhealthy ones (force=true targets all). journal_status inspects recovery fences; journal_repair atomically merges valid candidates and verifies persistence. Repair defaults to dryRun=true, preserves pending reads and never touches Workers/KB. Do not combine journal actions with force.

force.description: Recover ALL workers, even responsive ones.

action.description: Worker recovery, journal inspection or explicit repair.

dryRun.description: Preview journal_repair; explicitly false to persist reconciliation.

name: genexus_delete_object
description: Delete an object from the KB through its native SDK identity. Irreversible — confirm=true required. Inspects native incoming references first; dryRun=true previews without deleting it.

dryRun.description: When true, returns the resolved object and native references without deleting it.

expectedVersion.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token returned by a prior dry run.

name: genexus_refactor
description: Run GeneXus refactor: rename, extract procedure, extract local subroutine, or WWP condition set. For KB-wide rename with call-site patching (RenameObject/RenameAttribute), the response includes a patched-site count from RefactorService. dryRun=true previews what would change without persisting.

action.description: Refactoring operation to execute; rename and extraction actions change KB source or metadata.

target.description: Primary object or symbol to refactor.

newName.description: New name for the renamed object, attribute, or variable.

objectName.description: RenameVariable: target object name containing the variable.

procedureName.description: ExtractProcedure: name for the newly created Procedure.

subroutineName.description: ExtractSubroutine: name for the newly created Subroutine.

controlAttribute.description: WWPSetCondition: control or attribute name to attach condition.

type.description: RenameObject: object type (e.g. WebPanel, Transaction, Procedure) to disambiguate when several objects share the name — e.g. a WebPanel vs the same-named Table behind a Transaction. Ignored by RenameAttribute/RenameVariable.

dryRun.description: When true, returns what would be changed without persisting.

name: genexus_run_object
description: Resolve runtime URL for an object (webRoot + aspx + encoded args). gamSession='auto'|{user,pass,...} captures GAM cookies. Does NOT open a browser. dryRun=true returns the resolved URL without performing GAM login.

gamSession.description: 'auto' (use GXMCP_GAM_USER/PASS env) or {user, pass, repository?, loginUrl?}.

dryRun.description: When true, returns the resolved URL without performing the GAM login step.

name: genexus_format
description: Format a GeneXus code snippet using worker rules.

examples.code:
for each Customer where CustomerId = &Id
  &Name = CustomerName
endfor

name: genexus_gam
description: GAM / integrated-security provisioning via the SDK's IIntegratedSecurityService — distinct from genexus_security (env-scan/regex audit). action=status (default) is read-only: IsEnabledIntegratedSecurity + GAM-DB-reorganize flag. action=define_api / action=deploy are DESTRUCTIVE — they create/alter GAM security tables in the KB's datastore; no default reaches them, action must be set explicitly.

action.description: status (default, read-only) | define_api | deploy.

force.description: define_api only: force flag passed to DefineAPI.

forceTableCreation.description: deploy only: force GAM table creation.

name: genexus_properties
description: Properties API. get supports ordered batches (max 100, per-item errors). move is transactional with concurrency checks and rollback; it never runs lifecycle/tests. Use genexus_layout for controls.

action.description: Object-property operation to read or change metadata or move the object.

targets.description: action=get: read up to 100 objects in input order.

type.description: Optional object type disambiguator; used when a batch item omits type.

control.description: Optional layout control, variable (&Name), or attribute.

propertyName.description: get: property name/list/wildcard filter; set: property to change.

propertyNames.description: action=get: list of property names to return.

query.description: get: substring or * wildcard filter for property names.

projection.description: action=get: compact property subset (minimal, standard, full). Defaults to full.

properties.description: Batch set: map of propertyName to value applied in 1 transaction.

targetModule.description: move: typed alias for a Module destination.

folder.description: move: destination alias with Folder kind.

module.description: move: destination alias with Module kind.

destKind.description: move: disambiguate when a Folder and Module share a name.

dryRun.description: move: preview from/to and preserved parts without persisting.

baseVersion.description: move: opaque optimistic concurrency token returned by a prior read.

validationMode.description: set: run inline Specify (Spec+Gen, no Compile); returns diagnostics and can roll back on failure.

rollbackOnFailure.description: move: attempt compensating snapshot restoration if the SDK transaction rollback is insufficient (default true). set+validationMode=specify: request rollback after validation failure.

name: genexus_structure
description: Read or write the structure/data-model of GeneXus objects. update_visual now snapshots every part, checks optimistic concurrency, saves and re-reads the Transaction, and restores the complete snapshot when persistence or authored-part verification fails. Default form projections are allowed to follow Structure; user-authored forms are invariant. No structure action implicitly runs Specify, Generate, Build, Rebuild, compilation, reorganization, execution, or tests. Other actions cover indexes, attributes (set_attribute operates on global attribute definitions; use update_visual/move_attribute/remove_attribute for Transaction structure), levels, Domains (including enumValues), SubType Groups and subtype consistency (check_subtypes). For layout control trees use genexus_layout.

action.description: Structure operation to execute.

name.description: Object name. update_visual/move_attribute: Transaction name; create_index/get_indexes: Transaction or Table name.

attribute.description: move_attribute: existing attribute to reorder by native SDK identity.

before.description: move_attribute: place attribute before this attribute in the same level. Mutually exclusive with after/position.

after.description: move_attribute: place attribute after this attribute in the same level. Mutually exclusive with before/position.

position.description: move_attribute: zero-based final attribute position in the level. Mutually exclusive with before/after.

level.description: move_attribute: root (default) or an unambiguous subordinate level name.

dryRun.description: update_visual/move_attribute/create_index: validate and return the projected diff without changing any object, Attribute, hash, or version.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token for update_visual/move_attribute/create_index. Stale state returns VersionConflict before mutation.

payload.description: update_visual (Transaction):{children:[...]}; update_visual (SDT):{isCollection?,collectionItemName?,children:[{name,type?,length?,decimals?,basedOnDomain?,basedOnAttribute?,isCollection?,isLevel?,children?}]}. update_group:{members:[{name,subtypeOf}],remove?:[name]}. create_index:{attributes:["Attr"],unique?:true,name?,order?:"Ascending"|"Descending"}. Other actions keep their existing typed payloads.

validationMode.description: Explicitly run the inline Specify pass after selected writes. Never runs unless requested.

rollbackOnFailure.description: update_visual, move_attribute and create_index capture snapshots and verify rollback after any save or re-read divergence.

type.description: Optional object type disambiguator (e.g. 'Transaction', 'Table') when multiple objects share the same name.

name: genexus_authoring
description: Author members of object types the structure DSL doesn't cover. add_external_method / add_external_property add a method (with parameters) or property to an External Object; add_menu_option adds an option to a Menu (target = a KB object to call); add_condition adds a filter expression to a Data Selector. name = the target object.

action.description: Authoring operation to add a typed member or condition to a supported object.

name: genexus_layout
description: Layout/WebForm: get_tree, set_property, find_controls, inspect_surface, scan_mutators. Properties: genexus_properties; structure: genexus_structure get_visual.

action.description: Layout/WebForm operation to perform.

control.description: Control name within the layout or WebForm.

propertyName.description: Property name to modify (e.g. Caption, Visible, Enabled, Class).

value.description: Value to assign to the specified property.

query.description: find_controls: search query matching control names or captions.

changes.description: set_properties: batch array of {control, propertyName, value} objects.

height.description: add_printblock: height of the new printblock.

name: genexus_doc
description: Use to generate structured docs (wiki, dependency graph, health reports). Don't use for programmatic analysis (see genexus_analyze) or source (see genexus_read).

action.description: wiki: generate markdown docs; visualize: generate dependency graph; health: produce health report.

target.description: Object or domain name (required for wiki/visualize).

kb.description: KB alias for health or other worker-backed document actions.

name: genexus_search_source
description: Regex/semantic search across Procedure/DataProvider/WebPanel/Transaction source. Restrict a scan by object name, persisted GUID, EntityKey, or module/folder-qualified path. Requires the KB index to be Ready — check genexus_lifecycle action=status if results look empty.

argMatches.description: Positional arg index to expected literal text.

objectName.description: Restrict the scan to these exact object name(s), comma-separated. Makes a search inside one known object O(object) not O(KB), and bypasses the type whitelist.

entityKey.description: Typed GeneXus EntityKey from genexus_list_objects verbose output.

startIndex.description: Legacy object-boundary resume. For a page that ended inside an object, prefer the opaque cursor returned in nextCursor.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from nextCursor; preferred when a result page ended inside an object. Do not edit.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget (default 30000). Raise it to scan more objects per call.

scope.description: Parts to scan with line-numbered context. Default [source]. webForm/layout scans the WebPanel/Transaction visual XML (control names, captions, classes, bindings).

fields.description: Whole-field metadata match (returns matchedValue, no line context). Default [source]. Prefer scope=[webForm] for line-context WebForm hits; use fields=[webForm] only for a coarse contains-match.

inline_read_top.description: 0-3. Inline reads of top N distinct objects in response.

name: genexus_kb
description: Manage open KBs, session selection, startup config, Knowledge Base creation, and GeneXus environments. create bootstraps a brand new KB via native MSBuild tasks; list/open/close/select/set_session_default/set_persistent_default/set_default operate on WorkerPool and session context; select sets active KB for current session only without mutating config; set_persistent_default explicitly persists startup default to config.json and returns persistedTo; set_default is a legacy persistent default operation; set_startup/get_startup mirror IDE 'Set As Startup Object'; list_environments lists all configured environments; get_environment reads the active environment; set_environment selects an environment.

action.description: KB pool or startup-selection operation to perform.

alias.description: KB alias. open: auto from path basename if omitted.

kb.description: KB alias for environment actions; required when more than one Worker is open.

path.description: Absolute KB path (required for create and for open if alias not in config).

driver.description: open only: per-KB driver override. Use com-gxpublic for classic GeneXus 8/9 KBs; otherwise omit to resolve the catalog driver.

installationPath.description: open only: per-KB GeneXus installation/provider root. For GX8 this is typically the folder containing gxw32.exe (for example ...\ARTech\GeneXus\gxw80).

name.description: Object name (required for set_startup) or Knowledge Base name (optional for create, defaults to directory name).

environment.description: Environment name/folder (required for set_environment), e.g. development.

persist.description: Persist KB to config.json for create and legacy set_default (default false for create, default true for set_default).

dbServer.description: create only: SQL Server instance name (default (LocalDB)\MSSQLLocalDB).

dbName.description: create only: target database name (default gx_kb_<name>).

dbUser.description: create only: database user for SQL authentication (optional).

dbPassword.description: create only: database password for SQL authentication (optional).

template.description: create only: generator template path or name, e.g. CSharp/csharp.kbtemplate (optional).

sdkPath.description: create only: explicit GeneXus SDK installation directory (optional).

major.description: open/create: target GeneXus major version, e.g. '8', '16', '17', or '18' (optional). For open, use with driver/installationPath to select a legacy SDK per KB.

openAfterCreate.description: create only: automatically open the KB and start a Worker instance after creation (default true).

dryRun.description: create only: preview KB creation plan without creating directories or running MSBuild (default false).

name: genexus_navigation
description: View navigation report (IDE Right-click → View Navigation). latest=true reads the most recent report from .gx/navigation-cache; latest=false runs fresh and refreshes that per-KB cache.

action.description: Navigation report operation to execute.

latest.description: Read the most recent cached navigation when true; when false, run fresh and refresh the per-KB navigation cache.

name: genexus_api
description: Inspect HTTP procedures and native API routes. action=list|describe|routes_inspect|routes_clone|routes_update|snapshot|diff_baseline|export_openapi|import_openapi. API route writes use typed ServiceGroupSource, optimistic versioning, full snapshot, rollback and post-save reread; no lifecycle operation is implicit.

action.description: API introspection, route-editing, or baseline operation to perform.

expectedVersion.description: versionToken returned by the preceding dry run or inspection.

versionToken.description: Backward-compatible alias for expectedVersion; pass the token returned by the preceding dry run or inspection.

dryRun.description: routes_clone/routes_update: preview first; false writes only with expectedVersion or versionToken.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Restore the complete API snapshot when post-save verification diverges.

operation.description: Operation value carried by the reused request contract, e.g. REVERSE.

baseline.description: Baseline name under .gx/api-baselines/ or absolute path (action=diff_baseline).

name: genexus_apply_pattern
description: Apply a pattern (e.g. WorkWithPlus) to a parent (IDE Right-click → Apply Pattern). Transaction=family-gen; WebPanel/WebComponent/SDPanel=direct-attach (pass settings.template). mode=diagnose (or dryRun=true) returns findings without mutating. Working on Smart Devices? → resources/read uri=genexus://kb/skills/sd-panel-mobile for Main object semantics. mode=actions manages typed grid and form-level actions, persists and re-reads PatternInstance, supports dryRun diff and rollbackOnFailure, and never adds security permissions automatically.

pattern.description: Installed pattern name or GUID. Required for apply/diagnose; omit with reapply=true to infer from the existing instance.

mode.description: apply (default) mutates; diagnose returns reasons without applying. actions exposes typed WWP grid, form-level, and action-group editing.

action.description: mode=actions operation.

containerName.description: Form-level action container name, usually TableActions.

actionName.description: Name of the action to add, update, or remove. Form-level actions derive the GeneXus event Do<actionName>.

position.description: zero-based index among actions in group.

procedure.description: Target Procedure to execute on action click.

selection.description: Execution scope: current (single record) or multiple.

validate.description: apply mode only: optionally build the generated host. mode=actions never invokes Specify, Generate, Build, Rebuild, compilation, or tests.

dryRun.description: Alias for mode=diagnose. When true, returns pattern findings without mutating. With mode=actions it previews the typed action diff.

rollbackOnFailure.description: On a failed write or post-save verification, attempt to restore the original PatternInstance and report the rollback result.

name: genexus_edit_and_build
description: Edit + rebuild callers in one call. Returns edit diff + impact + a build block that may include taskId/pollTarget for lifecycle follow-up. validate=true/validationMode=specify validates the saved object; rollbackOnFailure restores its pre-write snapshot on specification failure.

content.description: New content. For mode=patch may be {find,replace} object.

patch.description: Same shape as genexus_edit.patch. Auto-sets mode=patch.

visualVerify.description: Post-edit headless screenshot + pixel-diff vs baseline. See tool-help.

name: genexus_security
description: Audit KB security. action=audit_gam scans GAM/env props; action=scan_secrets greps Source for credential-shaped literals; action=scan_native drives the native GeneXus Security Scanner (ISecurityScannerService). Returns findings with severity.

action.description: audit_gam: scans GAM and environment properties; scan_secrets: greps Source for credentials; scan_native: drives native GeneXus Security Scanner.

name: genexus_doctor
description: Health check: GX install, KB state, worker, cache age, recent telemetry. Paste output for triage when something feels off. When more than one KB is open, pass kb=<alias> to pick which one to diagnose.

kb.description: Alias of the KB to diagnose. Optional; required only when multiple KBs are open (otherwise the single open / default KB is used).

name: genexus_edit_form
description: Semantic WebForm edits. Actions: add_textblock, add_button, set_visibility, remove_control, wrap_in_fieldset.

action.description: Semantic WebForm control operation to execute.

parent.description: Parent control ID to insert the new control into.

event.description: add_button: event name to trigger on click.

controlIds.description: wrap_in_fieldset: list of control IDs to wrap inside the fieldset.

legend.description: wrap_in_fieldset: legend text for the fieldset container.

dryRun.description: Preview form modifications without persisting.

name: genexus_compare
description: Read-only SDK comparison. content adds diffs (part=read alias, partType, unified/omittedReason), preserving equal/differences. CRLF/CR to LF. Limits: input 1M UTF-16 units, diff 16K/part, JSON evidence 128KiB total; excess omitted. properties unchanged. See genexus_help.

type.description: Object type filter applied to both lookups, e.g. 'Transaction'.

name: genexus_module
description: GeneXus Module Manager over the SDK's IModuleManagerService. action=list (read-only: installed Module KB objects) | install (opcFile=<path to .opc file>, or name[+version] to install a named module) | install_builtin (name=<built-in module>) | update (name+version) | package/publish/restore (module lifecycle) | add_modules_server/search_modules_in_servers (configured module servers). install/install_builtin/update accept dryRun=true for a read-only preview (package identity, dependencies, affected modules) without calling the SDK install.

action.description: Module Manager operation to inspect, install, or update a module.

opcFile.description: install: absolute path to a .opc module package file.

outputPath.description: package: output directory; publish: output .opc file.

rebuild.description: package: include a rebuild before packaging.

confirm.description: Required for restore/publish/package when the operation changes KB or publishes externally.

source.description: add_modules_server: server URL or directory source.

preserveConfiguration.description: add_modules_server: preserve the existing server configuration when supported.

dryRun.description: install/install_builtin/update: when true, returns a read-only preview (package identity, dependencies, affected modules) without calling the SDK install.

name: genexus_merge
description: Merge two (or three, with an ancestor) KB objects via the SDK's IMergeService. mode=objects only (mode=models is unsupported — needs multiple KBModel instances not available in this worker). Omit objectBase for a 2-way merge (ignoreConflicts applies); pass objectBase for a 3-way merge. dryRun (default true) reports what would merge via IComparerService WITHOUT writing; dryRun=false performs the merge and saves it. WRITE + destructive.

objectBase.description: Optional common ancestor. Omit for a 2-way merge; pass for a 3-way merge.

type.description: Object type filter applied to all lookups, e.g. 'Transaction'.

ignoreConflicts.description: 2-way merge only: let the SDK auto-resolve conflicting parts instead of failing. Default false.

dryRun.description: true (default): report-only, no SDK MergeObjects call, nothing written. false: perform the merge and save it.

name: genexus_gxserver
description: GxServer (Team Development) sync. Read: status|pending|ignored|conflicts|history. pending lists locally-changed objects, each flagged ignoredForCommit (true = in the IDE 'Ignored Objects' tab, skipped by a full commit). ignored lists ONLY the excluded objects: commitIgnored (IDE Commit > Ignored Objects) + updateIgnored (IDE Update > Ignored Objects). Write (destructive; requires a GXserver-linked KB): commit (message; optional targets[] = commit ONLY those pending objects; reports committedObjects + remoteVersion) | update (applies changes into local KB; apply=false = download only; leaves conflicts flagged) | lock (target) | resolve (targets[] + strategy). theirs/automerge/update talk to the server and need creds via GXMCP_TEAMDEV_USER/PASSWORD env (url auto-resolves). Returns {connected:false} when KB is not linked.

action.description: GXserver/Team Development or CI pipeline operation to perform.

buildId.description: pipeline_output: build id to fetch output for.

rebuild.description: pipeline_run: full rebuild instead of incremental.

runTests.description: pipeline_run: run tests as part of the pipeline.

force.description: commit: force commit despite pending server-side changes.

apply.description: update: apply changes into local KB (default true); false = download package only.

async.description: update/commit: run as a background job — returns an operationId immediately; poll genexus_lifecycle(action=status|result, target=op:<id>). Use for a large update that would exceed the sync window.

strategy.description: resolve: which version wins — mine (keep local, default, creds-free), theirs (take server), automerge (3-way merge). theirs/automerge need server creds.

targets.description: commit: partial commit — object names to commit (all other pending objects are excluded). resolve: conflicted object names to resolve. Names must appear in action=pending/conflicts.

name: genexus_kb_version
description: SDK KB version tree via KBVersionHelper. list and changed_objects are read-only; changed_objects compares active Design with a frozen version and returns paged NEW/CHANGED items without SQL. Other actions mutate. createdAt may be unavailable; lastUpdate is separate.

action.description: Version delta or tree operation.

parentVersion.description: Parent version name (freeze/branch). Defaults to the active version.

targetVersion.description: Version to activate (set_active) or revert to (revert).

fromVersion.description: changed_objects frozen baseline; revert source; omit for latest frozen.

name: genexus_browser
description: Headless-browser verification umbrella. action=smoke (HTTP 200 + clean console), a11y (axe), wcag (caption/tooltip lint), capture (console/network/exceptions), cross (multi-engine), preview (render WebPanel + capture HTML/a11y/screenshot, optionally diff baseline). preview uses mode=render|run (default render; run auto-resolves the KB launcher, IDE F5 parity).

action.description: Browser verification operation to execute.

name: genexus_db
description: Database umbrella. Actions: drift_check|drift_report; optimize_analyze|optimize_suggest|optimize_report; sql_ddl|sql_navigation; sample_data; records_query|records_insert|records_update (typed Transaction rows; query read-only; writes dryRun; no business rules); types_list|types_describe|types_validate; reorg_impact; reorg_preview (non-mutating; deep uses ImpactDatabase); translations_import.

action.description: Database operation. records_query is read-only; records_insert/records_update default to dryRun=true and require the matching single-use v2 preview token for persistence.

deep.description: reorg_impact/reorg_preview only: run ISpecifierService.ImpactDatabase (specification, build-heavy) for the authoritative AnalysisResult. Default false (cheap timestamp heuristic).

dataStore.description: records_*: existing active-environment datastore; defaults to the SDK default.

where.description: records_query/update: equality filters only; update requires a filter.

databaseManagedFields.description: records_*: reviewed trigger-maintained fields; excludes keys and supplied values. Included in the preview token.

expectedCount.description: records_update: defaults to exactly one matched record.

expectedVersion.description: records_*: v2 token from the matching write dry-run; query/v1 tokens cannot authorize writes.

dryRun.description: records_insert/update: validate and reread the plan without writing.

rollbackOnFailure.description: records_*: default true; validation failures roll back before commit. Post-commit compensation is refused to preserve concurrent writers.

name: genexus_versioning
description: Versioning umbrella. action: history_list|history_get|history_save|history_restore (snapshot store; restore+discard=true is IDE 'Discard changes' parity) | undo (revert last N edits) | time_travel (recover bytes from a past git commit) | blame (git blame an object part) | diff (text: mode=textVsText|currentVsText) | diff_generated (against=last-build|git-head).

action.description: History, diff, time-travel, or rollback operation to perform.

name.description: Object name for history, diff, time_travel, or blame.

part.description: Object part name, e.g. Source, Rules, Events.

partName.description: Legacy alias for part on history actions.

snapshot.description: history_restore: snapshot label or path to restore.

discard.description: history_restore: true for IDE 'Discard changes' parity.

dryRun.description: history_restore/undo: preview without mutating the KB.

filePath.description: blame: absolute or KB-relative file path.

left.description: diff: left-side text or snapshot label.

right.description: diff: right-side text or snapshot label.

name: genexus_io
description: IO umbrella for assets, Object Text exchange, screenshots, OCR. action: asset_find|asset_read|asset_write | read_blob | export_part|import_part (single part) | export_kb_to_text|import_text_to_kb|validate_kb_text_files|delete_kb_objects (official GeneXus for Agents Object Text parity) | export_unified|screenshot_publish|ocr.

action.description: Asset, single-part, SDK text-tree, batch Object Text, screenshot, or OCR operation.

path.description: asset/screenshot_publish/ocr: file path; Object Text import/validate may use a manifest directory.

name.description: single object name or comma-separated selector; export_unified uses one object.

targets.description: Object Text selector array. Items may be names or {name,type} objects. Omit for export_kb_to_text to export the full indexed KB.

inputPath.description: import_part: source file; import_text_to_kb/validate_kb_text_files: manifest or directory.

part.description: Object Text or part-exchange part name (e.g. Source, Rules, WebForm). For native format, part=all serializes authored textual parts into one sectioned .gx document.

parts.description: native export: explicit authored parts to include in one sectioned .gx document; part=all uses the safe default part set.

format.description: Object Text export/import format. legacy preserves .gxtext compatibility; native creates the SDK text tree under src/ and ref/ without GX4A DLLs.

mode.description: native export mode. all writes every selected object; newAndModified uses the SDK/index version token; newOnly keeps existing files.

includeDependencies.description: native export/import: include Calls/Tables dependency closure under ref/.

includeReferences.description: Alias of includeDependencies for native src/ref exchange.

includeVisualParts.description: native export/import: include WebForm/Layout companions (.web.xml or .report.xml).

includeModuleMetadata.description: native export: emit deterministic module.toml metadata for modules represented in src/ref; no package DLL is loaded.

includeModulePackages.description: native export: copy matching official .opc reference packages from the selected GeneXus installation into ref/; defaults to includeDependencies and never copies DLLs.

includeTableProjections.description: native export: emit official SDK Table structures under src/#tables for selected Transactions; opt-in because tables may be shared/derived.

includeChildren.description: filesystem parity: recurse into child directories or expand Module/Folder selectors recursively; default true.

listOnly.description: filesystem parity: return the resolved plan without reading the SDK, writing files or mutating the KB.

stopOnError.description: filesystem parity: stop after the first item-level error and report remaining work for a safe resume.

skip.description: filesystem parity: skip this many deterministic planned items before processing; useful for resuming a large batch.

indentString.description: native export: optional prefix applied to non-empty source lines inside the object body; omitted preserves source indentation.

forceSave.description: text import: force the official WriteService persistence path even when the content is unchanged.

rollbackOnFailure.description: native multi-part import: restore parts already written when a later SDK part write fails; reports reconciliationRequired if a prior snapshot cannot be read or restored.

importMissingReferences.description: native import: include reference/dependency files when importing a tree.

ignore.description: list_text_files/validate_text_in_memory: relative file or directory prefixes to ignore; batch KB actions also accept object selectors.

initialSync.description: text_mirror_start: schedule a full catch-up immediately after start.

full.description: text_mirror_catchup: reconcile the complete indexed KB instead of only queued changes.

pathPrefix.description: Object Text KB object-path prefix filter.

confirm.description: delete_kb_objects: required for a real delete; dryRun remains non-mutating.

dryRun.description: Object Text import/delete preview without persisting changes.

async.description: Run a batch Object Text operation as a cancellable background job when supported.

name: genexus_variable
description: Variables CRUD. add accepts varName or variables[] batch; modify changes type atomically. basedOn binds a Domain; basedOnAttribute (or typeName Attribute:<name>) binds an Attribute by native SDK identity preserving picture/semantics. objectType=BusinessComponent with objectName+module binds a modular BC by EntityKey/GUID and verifies it after save. length/decimals override size; collection=true declares a collection; untyped add inherits a same-named attribute with its binding. modify refuses to silently drop an Attribute binding (AttributeBindingWouldBeLost); reads surface basedOn. dryRun validates and previews without mutation; async returns an operationId.

action.description: Variable-part operation to add, delete, or modify a variable.

varName.description: Single-variable form (add/delete/modify). For batch add use variables[] instead.

variables.description: Batch add only: one object per variable — {varName, typeName?, basedOn?, basedOnAttribute?, length?, decimals?, collection?}. Added before a single save.

typeName.description: Primitive (Character/Numeric/VarChar/Date/...), SDT/BC/Domain name, Attribute:<name>, or WebSession. VarChar keeps VARCHAR semantics.

newTypeName.description: modify alias for the replacement type; accepted alongside typeName.

dataType.description: modify alias for the replacement type; accepted alongside typeName.

objectType.description: add/modify: resolve an object-backed variable natively instead of interpreting typeName as a Domain.

objectName.description: Business Component Transaction name, without module when module is passed separately.

module.description: Module owning objectName. Required to disambiguate modular Business Components.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token for an object-backed add/modify. Stale state returns VersionConflict before mutation.

length.description: add/modify optional: overrides the length parsed from typeName.

decimals.description: add/modify optional: overrides decimals parsed from typeName.

collection.description: add/modify optional: declare the variable as a collection.

basedOn.description: Domain name, or Attribute:<name> for an attribute binding (prefer basedOnAttribute).

basedOnAttribute.description: Attribute name (or Attribute:<name>) to bind; preserves picture/semantics.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the typed diff without changing any object, Attribute, hash, or version.

validationMode.description: Explicitly run the inline Specify pass after a legacy variable write. Never runs unless requested.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Object-backed variables always snapshot the complete owner and restore it on save/re-read divergence.

async.description: Run as a background job. Result returns operationId/job_id for genexus_lifecycle polling.

estimated_seconds.description: When async=true, expected runtime used for progress/job metadata (default 30).

name: genexus_telemetry
description: Observability umbrella. action: executions (recent invocations) | watch_event (ops mentioning an event) | friction_append|friction_tail (.gx/friction.jsonl) | learning_report (aggregate friction) | logs (worker_debug.log tail) | profile_analyze|profile_hotspots|profile_correlate (GeneXus profiler XML).

action.description: Telemetry, profiling, or friction-log operation to perform.

event.description: watch_event: event name to match in operation payload.

tool.description: friction_append: tool name that produced the friction entry.

message.description: friction_append: description of the friction encountered.

n.description: friction_tail: number of recent lines to return.

tail.description: logs: number of tail lines from worker_debug.log.

grep.description: logs: substring filter on log lines.

path.description: profile_*: path to the GeneXus profiler XML file.

top.description: profile_hotspots: top-N hottest procedures to return.

name: genexus_create
description: Creation. action: object (Transaction/Procedure/WebPanel/SDT/API/Domain/Dashboard/Folder/Module; type='API' scaffolds a REST API object with one HTTP-verb block per object; type='Folder'/'Module' create containers; folder/module places the new object there; SDT and Transaction take optional firstItem/firstItemType; Domain takes dataType+length or enumValues; NOT WWP — use genexus_apply_pattern) | popup (popup WebPanel with Form type='layout' body) | sd_panel_create|sd_panel_inspect|sd_panel_edit | save_as (clone parts) | scaffold|translate|sample (forge) | template (kpi_header|empty_state|confirm_dialog) | object_atomic (issue #62: all-or-nothing create/update of an object with variables[], rules[], parms[], properties{} and source in ONE validated call — pre-validates every field before the first save, composes the SDK write primitives, compensates on failure, dryRun previews, validate=true runs the inline Specify pass, update mode guards concurrent writes via expectedVersion). | curl_procedure imports a REST-consumer Procedure from a curl command through the GeneXus SDK.

action.description: Object-creation or scaffold operation to perform.

curl.description: curl_procedure: the curl command to import as a Procedure.

type.description: Object type to create (Transaction, Procedure, WebPanel, SDT, API, Domain, Dashboard, Folder, Module).

objectType.description: Legacy alias for type when creating an object.

name.description: Name of the object to create, clone, or update.

description.description: Human-readable description / title of the object.

firstItem.description: object SDT/Transaction optional: name of the initial structure item/key attribute to seed (SDK requires >=1). Defaults to <ObjectName>Id for Transaction and Item1 for SDT.

firstItemType.description: object SDT/Transaction optional: type of the seeded first item/key attribute (Character/Numeric/VarChar/…). Defaults to Numeric(4) for Transaction and VarChar for SDT.

folder.description: object: Folder destination (created in Root, then moved+verified).

module.description: object: Module destination (created in Root, then moved+verified).

parentPath.description: object: folder/module destination (fallback when folder/module absent).

mode.description: object_atomic: create (fail if exists), update (fail if missing), auto (default — create or update by existence).

variables.description: object_atomic: one object per variable — {varName, typeName?, length?, decimals?, collection?}. Validated before any save; errors are attributed to variables[N].

rules.description: object_atomic: rule lines (e.g. "Parm(in:&Id);"). Send actual line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before the first save.

parms.description: object_atomic: parameter entries rendered into a Parm rule — bare names ("&Id") or prefixed ("out:&Msg").

source.description: object_atomic: Source part text. Send actual line breaks; literal backslash sequences \r\n, \n, or \r are rejected before the first save.

properties.description: object_atomic: object-level properties applied via the genexus_properties path (propertyName → value).

expectedVersion.description: object_atomic update: optimistic concurrency token returned as `version` by a prior atomic create/update/read; a mismatch fails with ConcurrentModification instead of overwriting concurrent changes.

validate.description: object_atomic: run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen) before confirming success. On failure with rollbackOnFailure=true, a freshly-created object is deleted so the operation stays all-or-nothing.

validationMode.description: Issue #60: with action=object, run the inline Specify pass (Spec+Gen, no Compile) after creation, returning structured spc*/gen* diagnostics in the same call. Combines with rollbackOnFailure.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Issue #60: with action=object and validationMode=specify, roll back the created object when the specify pass reports errors. A fresh object has no pre-write snapshot, so rollback reports rolledBack=false — delete it via genexus_delete_object if spec fails.

dryRun.description: popup/save_as/template/object.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency versionToken for atomic create/update.

updateExisting.description: object_atomic: allow updating existing object if it already exists.

name: genexus_memory
description: Per-KB fact store. action: save (fact required; optional target/type/tags; dedups on identical fact+object, bumping a hit count) | recall (filter by target/type/tags — ANY match; no filter returns all) | list (all, newest first) | forget (tombstone by id) | promote (lift a friction-log message into a memory, tagged 'friction') | consolidate (dreaming — merge redundant/overlapping facts within scope; dryRun=true previews, dryRun=false compacts memory.jsonl). Persisted to .gx/memory/memory.jsonl.

action.description: Persistent agent-memory operation to perform.

target.description: object name this memory is about.

type.description: object type this memory is about.

message.description: promote: friction text to promote into a memory.

dryRun.description: consolidate: true previews proposed merges without writing; false (default) applies and compacts memory.jsonl.

name: genexus_transfer
description: Real XPZ export/import over the SDK's IKnowledgeManagerService — dependency-aware, IDE Export/Import parity (NOT the filesystem copy genexus_io/kb_import do). action=export (targets[]+outputFile; includeDependencies=true exports transitive closure) | inspect (explore an .xpz, read-only) | import (apply into KB; dryRun defaults true=preview via ExploreExport; dryRun=false requires confirm=true).

action.description: XPZ export, inspection, or import operation to perform.

includeDependencies.description: export: compute transitive dependency closure (Calls, Tables) and export all referenced objects.

dryRun.description: import: true (default) previews; false applies (needs confirm).

name: genexus_deploy
description: Deploy application over the SDK. action=list_targets (read-only, default) enumerates deployment target types (IDeploymentTargetService); action=deploy (destructive, confirm=true) runs IDeploymentService.Deploy(model).

action.description: Deployment-target or deployment execution operation to perform.

name: genexus_generator_reference
description: Native typed .NET generator references used by GxExternalReference. list and dry-run actions are read-only. add/remove validate a managed assembly when a path is supplied, require optimistic baseVersion for changes, save only the native GeneratorsPart, reread it, and restore the complete generator-property snapshot on verification failure. No lifecycle action runs implicitly.

action.description: Typed .NET generator-reference operation to perform.

environment.description: Active GeneXus Environment name; the tool never switches environments.

assembly.description: Assembly file name for add/remove, e.g. SpreadsheetLibrary.dll.

assemblyPath.description: Absolute path or KB-relative path used to validate a managed assembly. Required for add unless found in a standard model/bin location.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic token returned by list or a dry-run. Required for a real state change.

dryRun.description: Force add/remove to remain read-only.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Restore and verify the complete prior generator-property snapshot if save/reread diverges.

name: genexus_wwp
description: Typed WorkWithPlus action, form-level action, tab, grid, native table-type, and structural edits with dryRun, optimistic concurrency, exact snapshots, post-save reread, projection verification, and rollback. set_table_type mutates only an existing table type through the native PatternInstance SDK and preserves children, bindings, events, names, classes, defaultType, and childrenOrderedList. No lifecycle operation is implicit. Settings: embedded and separate WWP templates, paged reads and exact table-class dryRun; saves remain blocked.

action.description: WorkWithPlus action-group, tab, grid-attribute, or explicit native structural operation to perform.

group.description: Action group name. add_action creates it when absent; update/remove use it as a filter.

containerName.description: add_user_action: form-level action container, usually TableActions.

actionName.description: Action name. add_user_action derives the GeneXus event Do<actionName>.

caption.description: Action caption. For a DropDownComponent pass the GeneXus expression used for the closed button, for example &Context.EmpresaDescricao.

procedure.description: add/update: associated Procedure; existence is validated against the KB.

selection.description: add/update: execution scope for grid actions.

enabledWhen.description: Availability condition stored verbatim; expression semantics are not validated.

confirm.description: Confirmation prompt; required to delete unless dryRun.

fromGroup.description: move_action: source group (optional; searched across groups when omitted).

dryRun.description: Return a typed diff and versionToken without mutation.

rollbackOnFailure.description: On a failed write or post-save verification, restore the original PatternInstance when possible.

children.description: add_tab controls; flat children are wrapped in a responsive table. Nested table children accept the same control shape.

userActionName.description: replace_web_component_with_user_action: resulting UserAction name; defaults to sourceName.

tablePath.description: set_table_type: existing table breadcrumb by names or indexed table segments; replace_web_component_with_user_action: full breadcrumb including the source node, for example TableHeader > TableUserRole > EmpresaSelector.

tableType.description: set_table_type: requested native WWP table type. Only the existing table @type changes; defaultType and all child identity/metadata remain guarded.

gxobject.description: replace_web_component_with_user_action: existing WebComponent Gxobject to retain; it must match the current node.

template.description: Settings catalog path, wwp:<template-guid>, or unique template name.

limit.description: Settings nodes per page; offset=0, limit=0 includes full separate-template XML.

guid.description: Pattern Settings object GUID for settings_* actions.

nodePath.description: Settings node path returned by settings_read.

name: genexus_kb_diff
description: Gateway-only filesystem comparison of two KB directories. Requires kbA and kbB aliases or paths; no active KB selection is used.

name: genexus_kb_import
description: Gateway-only filesystem copy of one object between two KB directories. Requires source and object identity; run lifecycle index afterwards.

name: genexus_sandbox
description: Gateway-only filesystem sandbox management; clone or remove a KB directory without SDK dispatch.
